note: Proposals only. Nothing here changes a live question's status; each entry names its source so the grading loop can be checked against it.

retire_or_merge.why: same digit reaches volume_backs_move; scored 0 on 4 pairs
flipped at the same second as two_day_position and week_position all day

horizon_experiments.what: grade the 30-minute sum against a flat band that follows the clock: 0.12 sigma before 10:30, 0.07 sigma midday, 0.06 sigma after 14:00
horizon_experiments.keep_if: over the same 40 graded reads the clock band's hit rate on next_30 beats the fixed 0.12 band's and the flat share lands nearer three in five in each part of the day than it does under the fixed band.

horizon_experiments.what: a third sum, next_15, on the same sentences as next_30 and next_60, shadow only, graded by the bars at 15 minutes against a flat band of 0.04 sigma
horizon_experiments.keep_if: after 40 graded reads its Brier score beats always saying flat and no single option holds 90% or more of its picks.

horizon_experiments.what: grade the 30-minute sum on the first touch of 0.17 sigma either way inside the 30 minutes, instead of where price ends at the mark
horizon_experiments.keep_if: after 40 graded reads at least one live question's tracking score rises from 0 to above the 40-read noise floor without next_30's hit rate falling below what end-point grading gives on the same reads.
